title: rosa canina var. ascita
intro: Rosa canina var. ascita, commonly known as Ascite Rose or Wild Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species. It is a type of shrub that is native to the Mediterranean region and is known for its fragrant flowers and edible fruits. The health benefits of Rosa canina var. ascita include its potential to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and improve cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and carotenoids, and are thought to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
